messages:
rachel: Quick follow-up from the UX review - focusing on download / copy flow after key creation, localization of expiry text, and motion / accessibility notes.
david: Good call. What specific problems did you spot?
mohit: Saw a few issues in translation tests: pluralization for \u201cExpires in 1 day\u201d vs \u201cExpires in 2 days\u201d breaks when copy is concatenated. We should switch to ICU plural rules and avoid building strings clientside. Also timezones: relative times must be localized to the project timezone or explicitly to user locale.
anya: Another big one: the success drawer currently auto-focuses the Download action and in Chrome the file dialog pops open immediately which blocks screen readers. Auto-triggering downloads on creation is a no-go for accessibility. Proposed: never auto-trigger. Provide an explicit keyboard-focusable Download link and a separate Copy button.
rachel: Proposed UX flow: after creating a key, show a success drawer with masked secret and two primary actions: "Copy secret" and "Download .txt". Copy uses navigator.clipboard.writeText with an aria-live polite announcement "Secret copied to clipboard". Download is only triggered by explicit user click. Add visible instruction: "This secret is shown once - store it securely now."
david: Microcopy tweak: change "You will only see this once" to "This secret is shown once - store it securely now." That reads better in translations and avoids modal punctuation issues.
mohit: For the expiry pill next to keys use ICU pluralization and a zero-case: instead of "Expires in 0 days" show "Expires today". Use localized relative strings; do not hardcode English patterns. Also include a title attribute with ISO timestamp for users who need exact values.
anya: Motion and a11y: the success drawer currently slides in 300ms and focus jumps immediately which causes some screen readers to miss the announcement. Respect prefers-reduced-motion; if reduced motion is set, open instantly and move focus synchronously. Otherwise, delay focus move until animation end, or use a visible offscreen announcer to narrate when ready. Drawer must trap focus and have role=dialog, aria-modal=true, and aria-labelledby pointing to header.
rachel: Edge case: user navigates away before copying. Current impl leaves secret in memory a short time and clears it which can lead to accidental retention. Better: show a clear ephemeral drawer and if user navigates away, display a post-creation page that says "Secret not saved - you will not be able to retrieve it again." Encourage use of Download or secure vault.
david: Permissions edgecases: some browsers disallow clipboard writes in cross-origin frames or when user gesture is absent. If clipboard.writeText fails, show inline fallback guidance: "Copy failed - press Ctrl+C / Cmd+C or use Download .txt" and ensure the Copy button exposes aria-describedby linking to this fallback.
mohit: i18n-bot note: ensure all strings use translation IDs and are not composed at runtime. Add tests for pluralization and right-to-left rendering for Arabic/Hebrew where layout can affect the secret container.
i18n-bot: Reference: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/issues/900 - i18n for key expiry and create flows
anya: Keyboard flow: when drawer opens, focus should land on "Copy secret". Tab order: Copy -> Download -> Close. Escape closes drawer and returns focus to the original Create CTA (restore focus). When secret is revealed with a Show button, move focus to the secret container and announce via aria-live polite: "Secret revealed. Copy now - it will not be shown again."
rachel: Color/contrast: secret text and copy button live on bg-muted. Run contrast tests; increase token contrast if needed. Make sure Download link has visible focus ring.
david: Tests: add e2e checks for 1) copy action emits aria-live text, 2) download link present and clickable, 3) reduced-motion respected (no slide), 4) ICU pluralization for expiry pill.
mohit: Developer note: store expiry timestamp in UTC ISO on the API and expose both relative and absolute values to the client. Let the client render relative with Intl.RelativeTimeFormat and fallback to absolute if Intl is unavailable.
anya: Accessibility nit: the masked secret preview should have an aria-label like: "Secret masked ending with xYz" rather than exposing full secret; when revealed, give an announcement: "Secret revealed - shown once."
rachel: Action items: 1) Update create + success drawer per above flow (no auto-download, explicit Copy + Download, clear one-time-warning); 2) i18n: switch to ICU pluralization and ensure translation IDs are used; 3) implement reduced-motion and delay focus until animation ends; 4) add fallback path for blocked clipboard writes; 5) add e2e and a11y tests and update style tokens if contrast fails; 6) draft spec + attach mocks and PR stub.
mohit: I'll open the i18n PR with test cases.
i18n-bot: PR stub: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/901
rachel: Thanks everyone - I'll collect these into a short spec and ping eng for a sync. :sparkles:
